# The process location beats the user location, and only for the key it names.
# Taking the variable away gives the file its key back, which is what makes it
# an override for the process location rather than an edit.
user {"store":"A","log_sink":"L"}
# setup 1: ok
env store B
# setup 2: ok
load
# expect 3: ok store=B/environment log_sink=L/user [CFG-R1] [CFG-W3]
key store
# expect 4: ok value=B from=environment [CFG-W3]
key log_sink
# expect 5: ok value=L from=user [CFG-P1]
env store -
# setup 6: ok
load
# expect 7: ok store=A/user log_sink=L/user [CFG-W3]
